title: Nintendo joins Best Buy for midnight Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 restock launch
text:
Nintendo joins Best Buy for midnight Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 restock launch 
 Subscribe Sign in News Nintendo joins Best Buy for midnight Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 restock launch
 November 5 will be another opportunity to get the Zelda Switch 2
 Adam Vjestica Oct 28, 2026 3 Share (Credit: Kevin Lee/The Shortcut) 📅 The Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 releases on Thursday, October 27
 🚨 Our Zelda Switch 2 restock tracker @mattswider on X will send out an alert when stock appears 
 😲 Nintendo Store held a surprise restock on October 26 and is holding a midnight launch event on November 5
 🙏 Other retailers may be holding back stock for launch day, too
 Walmart: Zelda Switch 2 console 
 Best Buy: Zelda Switch 2 console 
 GameStop: Zelda Switch 2 console 
 Target: Zelda Switch 2 console 
 Nintendo: Zelda Switch 2 console 
 🚨 We’re tracking Zelda Switch 2 stock updates. If you’d like to know when more stock arrives, follow Matt Swider on X and turn on notifications. You can also become a free or paid subscriber to The Shortcut to help support our work. 🚨 
 🚨 Want the Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2? Drop your email for restock alerts before it sells out. ⤵️
 Subscribe We’re expecting to see a Zelda 40th anniversary Switch 2 restock tomorrow at major retailers like Walmart, as the console and Pro Controller are set to launch. However, Nintendo has joined Best Buy in announcing a midnight launch event for The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time on November 5, where limited quantities of the special edition console will be available. 
 (Credit: Kevin Lee/The Shortcut) There is a catch, though. To attend the in-store event, which will be held on November 4 at Nintendo San Francisco and November 5 at Nintendo New York, a Warp Pipe Pass is required, which means capacity will be limited. 
 If you’re lucky enough to receive a Warp Pipe Pass (they’re currently fully booked), you’ll be able to purchase The Legend of Zelda 40th Anniversary Edition console, Zelda 40th Anniversary Nintendo Switch 2 Pro Controller and display stand, the Zelda 40th Anniversary Switch 2 Pro Controller on its own, and the Zelda 40th Anniversary carrying case and screen protector. 
 Purchases will be limited to one “per customer” and will be sold on a “first come, first served basis.”
 Why you should follow our Zelda Switch 2 restock tracker 
 Obviously, many will be looking to receive the Zelda Switch 2 before November 5, and an instore event isn’t exactly ideal for many. That’s where our exclusive Zelda Switch 2 restock tracker comes in, as we’re providing up-to-the-second US store inventory checks. Those who follow Matt Swider on X and turn on notifications will be the first to know when new stock is live, as you can see in the post below. 
 Matt Swider (The Shortcut) @ mattswider Zelda Switch 2 console in stock at the Nintendo Store
 nintendo.com/us/store/produ… 4:37 PM · Oct 26, 2026 · 67K Views 18 Replies · 4 Reposts · 75 Likes We’re strongly expecting retailers like Walmart to have stock on launch day, especially as it’s the largest retailer in the US. Cancellations can also occur in the run up to release, meaning more stock is made available that was previously taken. Thursday and Friday mornings is also when Walmart tends to offer restocks online.
 (Credit: The Shortcut) We’re predicting other retailers like Target, GameStop and Amazon will also get a new wave of consoles on launch day, and we’ll notify you if and when any Zelda Switch 2 restocks appear.
 You can trust our restock tracker as we helped over 400,000 people buy Sony’s console when it was in and out of stock for two years. We’ve since made it our goal to help our subscribers purchase hard-to-find items. We’ve done the same with the PS5 30th anniversary edition and many more in-demand products.
